natural_body: 40% discount lifts acquisition and revenue but cuts 30-day retention 12%; use selectively.

first.rationale: Prioritize simplifying onboarding because completion is down 4% and inherited evidence indicates shorter onboarding improves completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. Verify the onboarding and discount records before committing, since pricing pressure is material but prior discounting showed a retention cost that may undermine sustainable qualified revenue.
